event_summary: A colorful teapot-shaped ornament remains centered on a black circular base while its visible orientation steadily changes.
raw_event_description: At the start, the teapot ornament is upright on a black round base on a wooden tabletop, with the red handle visible on the left and the red spout on the right. Across the video, the teapot turns in place: the spout gradually comes toward the front center, then continues across to the left side while the handle becomes more visible on the right. The ornament stays intact, centered, and upright; the camera framing and focus remain stable.

reasons: The main teapot-shaped object is fully visible at the beginning.
The object is already undergoing continuous orientation change at the beginning.
The tabletop, base, and background are visible.
